steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: NEA Task 2 is a food preparation assessment worth 35% of the total GCSE grade (AQA 8585). It is completed in controlled conditions over approximately 20 hours.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Task 2 requires students to plan, prepare, cook, and present a menu of three dishes (plus accompaniments) in response to a set brief, typically within a 3-hour practical session.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The brief specifies a context and target group, e.g. 'Plan and prepare a menu for a teenager following a vegetarian diet' or 'Produce a menu for a family on a low budget'.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Task 2 portfolio must include: research into the brief, analysis of the task, menu planning and justification, nutritional analysis, time plan, costings, practical skills evidence, and evaluation.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Plan a menu that shows the WIDEST range of skills possible — include at least one complex skill per dish. Your time plan must be realistic: allow time for preparation, cooking, washing up between dishes, and final presentation. Always justify dish choices by linking them back to the brief: nutritional needs, target group, budget, skills demonstrated. The evaluation should be honest and reflective — identifying what went wrong and how you would fix it earns more marks than claiming everything was perfect.
